svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The five rules of Capability Slice Architecture
svg.desc: 1. Slice by scenario: Never by layout block. A capability owns one user scenario, even when it spans several blocks on screen. 2. The host assembles, it doesn’t think: No product conditions in the UI entry point. It connects slices, intents, and effects. 3. The runtime is the only bus: A capability never imports or calls another one. It reacts to the signals the other one sends. 4. Side effects live at the edge: The logic describes navigation, snackbars, and analytics as effects, and the host performs them. 5. Keep the decider small: About 150 lines or 12 facts. Past that, split the capability.
